Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred Maria of Aragon’s nationality from her title as “Queen of Portugal,” concluding she was Portuguese. This conflated marital title with birth nationality and ignored the sourced parentage showing she was a Spanish (Aragonese/Castilian) princess, daughter of Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon.
